published.citation: Mistry et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2194 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive: 4756 +/- 50 K, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166....9M/abstract

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 188474 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), so the colour is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
